**0044/0045 fix the two demonstrated panic failures; I found no blocker to those narrow fixes. I reproduced a pre-existing scheduler accounting defect that limits the repeat-completion claim.**

- **Gesture fix is sound:** [m_grid.lua:181](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/m_grid.lua:181) expands the range to buttons 3–6 and retains selected-button exclusion. Short dispatch is unchanged; long-hold release suppresses it at line 246.
- **Port isolation is sound:** [m_midi.lua:411](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/m_midi.lua:411) retains one debounce closure per port, so restarting one port cannot cancel another. Closures capture the port ID and resolve `midi_devices[id]` on each send; they do not retain an obsolete device object. The disconnected-port test does **not** establish mid-job disconnect/reconnect behavior.
- **Concrete accounting defect:** [scheduler.lua:94](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/scheduler.lua:94) decrements `active_count` even when the previous coroutine is already inactive but awaits cleanup. With four persistent background jobs, I reproduced: first panic completes **4/4 reported/actual**, repeat starts **4/7**, repeat completes **1/4**. This predates these candidates; update dispatch uses `.active`, so this demonstrates inaccurate accounting, not lost MIDI output. Minimal remedy: decrement only when the retained entry is active, and add this background-job scenario to [panic_scheduler_contract.lua:24](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/panic_scheduler_contract.lua:24).
- **Evidence supports scoped acceptance:** native evidence has now finished—all four controlled/real-time runs passed, with 2048 offs per port. Baseline records confirm `0/0/0` and `0/0/2048`. Source hashes match native and 482-test evidence; I independently reran the four scheduler scenarios successfully. [cases.py:2550](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/cases.py:2550) checks exact bytes/order, and [midi_window.py:8](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/midi_window.py:8) rejects capture gaps. No concrete input/capture false green found.

**CONFIDENCE: High** for these scoped fixes; active/pending notes, hot reconnect, and the full selected-page/button hold matrix remain unverified, so this is not full manual panic coverage.
